name: someday
description: Write letters to your future self, delivered by email from your own Cloudflare account.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: The **only** address that can sign in. Letters are delivered here.

SMTP_HOST.description: Your mail provider's SMTP server. Gmail: `smtp.gmail.com`. iCloud: `smtp.mail.me.com:587`. Fastmail: `smtp.fastmail.com`. Add `:587` for servers that use STARTTLS; the default port is 465.

SMTP_USER.description: The login for that SMTP server, usually your full email address.

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: An app password, not your normal password. Gmail: [create one here](https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords) (needs 2-Step Verification).
